description: A Highway Vehicle Routing Dataset During the 2019 Kincade Fire Evacuation is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "field recon", published or maintained by Xilei Zhao, University of Florida (ufl.edu). As wildfires become increasingly more prevalent and severe in California, it is imperative to study how people respond to wildfire events. To support wildfire evacuation research, this project publishes the first dataset to capture highway vehicle routing behavior during the 2019 Kincade Fire, Sonoma County, California. Coverage: Sonoma County, California, United States. DesignSafe files it as a "field recon" project. Keywords: Highway vehicle routing, GPS data, Wildfire evacuation, Kincade Fire, California. Published 2022-08-19. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
